faqs.question: Who is Yassin Mohammed?
faqs.answer: Yassin Mohammed is a Computer Science Engineering graduate and Python Full Stack Developer with experience in full-stack development and AI-powered applications.

faqs.question: What are Yassin's main technical skills?
faqs.answer: Yassin works with Python, JavaScript, SQL, React.js, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL and MySQL. His AI skills include LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, NLP, OCR, Sentence Transformers, Embeddings and Semantic Search.

faqs.question: Does Yassin have experience with AI?
faqs.answer: Yes. Yassin has experience with LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, NLP, OCR, Sentence Transformers, Embeddings and Semantic Search and has developed multiple AI-powered projects.

faqs.question: What AI projects has Yassin developed?
faqs.answer: Yassin has worked on AI projects including NUTU, ResumeShort AI, Resume AI and a Machine Learning based Diabetes Prediction System.

faqs.question: What is NUTU?
faqs.answer: NUTU is a personal RAG-based AI assistant being developed by Yassin. It allows people to ask questions about Yassin's professional background through text chat and voice conversations.

faqs.question: Does Yassin know FastAPI?
faqs.answer: Yes. Yassin has experience with FastAPI and has used it for AI-powered backend applications including ResumeShort AI and Resume AI.

faqs.question: Does Yassin know React?
faqs.answer: Yes. Yassin has experience developing reusable React.js components and has used React.js in full-stack projects.

faqs.question: Where did Yassin complete his B.Tech?
faqs.answer: Yassin completed his B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering with an IoT specialization from Kakatiya Institute of Technology and Science, Warangal.

faqs.question: Where did Yassin complete his Intermediate?
faqs.answer: Yassin completed his Intermediate in MPC from Resonance IIT Junior College, Warangal.

faqs.question: Where did Yassin complete his schooling?
faqs.answer: Yassin completed his school education at Oxford High School, Warangal.

faqs.question: What professional experience does Yassin have?
faqs.answer: Yassin worked at Encatch Tech Services in Hyderabad as a Software Engineer Intern, where he worked with React.js, REST APIs, Git, Agile Scrum, debugging and production application development.

faqs.question: What databases does Yassin know?
faqs.answer: Yassin has experience with PostgreSQL and MySQL.

faqs.question: What cloud and development tools does Yassin know?
faqs.answer: Yassin has worked with Git, GitHub, Docker, Postman, Swagger, Jira, GitHub Actions, AWS basics, Vercel, Render and Supabase.

faqs.question: What certifications does Yassin have?
faqs.answer: Yassin has completed AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials, Databricks Fundamentals, HackerRank SQL and Deloitte Data Analytics through Forage.
